court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: District Judge at Tiruvannamalai in C.M.A.No.2 of 2013
facts_of_case: The parties got married on 27.03.2015, but the husband left the matrimonial home and a petition was filed seeking dissolution of marriage. The trial court dismissed the suit.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other spouse has not fulfilled their marital obligations.
legal_principles.held: A perusal of the evidence of PW1, at the time of cross examination, would reveal the fact that it was the evidence of PW1 that after the marriage for 3 days there was no conjugal relationship between the petitioner and the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant divorce based on flimsy or unsubstantiated grounds.
legal_principles.held: A cursory reading of the above said evidence of PW1, at the time of cross examination would reveal the fact that it was the evidence of PW1 that after the marriage for 3 days there was no conjugal relationship between the petitioner and the respondent.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is preferred against the judgment and decree dated 15.09.2015 passed by the District Judge at Tiruvannamalai in C.M.A.No.2 of 2013.

use_for_drafting: advising on Hindu Marriage Act implications
